_about: Science words live only here (CLAUDE.md 'Site rules'). One plain sentence per term. Every term and every alias in aliases_en, every Nepali word in ne_block, and every word in never_on_screens is banned from the screens, tabs, tips and crop explainers (tests/test_words.py). 'basis' says where the meaning comes from. Every Nepali text was drafted by SI (Claude) on 2026-11-12 and needs native-speaker review before export; each node carries ne_review until a reviewer replaces it with their name and date.

say.en: Water that rises into the air from the soil and from plant leaves.
say.ne: माटो र बिरुवाका पातबाट उडेर हावामा जाने पानी।

terms.basis: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Chapter 1, 'Evapotranspiration process': 'The combination of two separate processes whereby water is lost on the one hand from the soil surface by evaporation and on the other hand from the crop by transpiration is referred to as evapotranspiration (ET).' https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e04.htm (opened 2026-11-12)

say.en: How much wetter or drier the soil is than usual for that time of year.
say.ne: वर्षको त्यो समयमा सामान्यभन्दा माटो कति बढी ओसिलो वा सुक्खा छ भन्ने कुरा।

terms.basis: Standard meaning: the difference from the usual (long-term average) value for the same time of year; the diary's soil words are terciles of 2001-2025 (CLAUDE.md 'Monthly calendar')

say.en: A greenness score from satellite pictures: the higher it is, the more living green leaves.
say.ne: भू-उपग्रहको तस्बिरबाट निकालिएको हरियालीको अङ्क: जति बढी, उति धेरै हरिया पात।

terms.basis: NASA Earth Observatory, 'Measuring Vegetation (NDVI & EVI)' (Weier & Herring 2000): 'NDVI is calculated from the visible and near-infrared light reflected by vegetation' and 'no green leaves gives a value close to zero'. https://science.nasa.gov/earth/earth-observatory/measuring-vegetation-ndvi-evi/ (opened 2026-11-12). Our NDVI: HLS and MODIS

say.en: The chance of nights near or below freezing (under 2 °C) that can hurt crops.
say.ne: बालीलाई हानि गर्न सक्ने, २ डिग्रीभन्दा चिसो रात पर्ने सम्भावना।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Frost': a frost night is Tmin below 0 C, risk band 0 to 2 C. Shown as bands, never as a count (rules.yaml cold_nights.frost_display_note)

say.en: The field's water account: rain and watering in; plant use, runoff and drainage out.
say.ne: खेतको पानीको हिसाब: वर्षा र सिँचाइ भित्र; बिरुवाको प्रयोग, बहाव र चुहावट बाहिर।

terms.basis: FAO-56 Chapter 8 root-zone water balance (CLAUDE.md 'Soil-water bucket')

say.en: The day the monsoon rains truly begin, with no long dry break soon after.
say.ne: मनसुनको पानी साँच्चै सुरु भएको दिन, जसपछि छिट्टै लामो खडेरी पर्दैन।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Monsoon onset': from 15 May, the first run of at least 2 wet days totalling 10 mm within 5 days, not followed by a 10-day dry spell in the next 20 days

say.en: Days in a year when the field has almost no green plants, seen from space.
say.ne: अन्तरिक्षबाट हेर्दा खेतमा हरियो बिरुवा लगभग नभएका वर्षका दिनहरू।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Bare days': interpolated NDVI below the rules.yaml threshold (start 0.25, to be tuned)

say.en: Growing different crops one after another on the same field, season by season.
say.ne: एउटै खेतमा मौसमअनुसार एकपछि अर्को फरक बाली लगाउने तरिका।

terms.basis: FAO AGROVOC c_6662: 'Technique of growing alternating species or families of crops in a specific field in a planned pattern or sequence.' (opened 2026-11-12)

say.en: A crop grown mainly to keep the soil covered and healthy between main crops.
say.ne: मुख्य बालीहरूको बीचमा माटो ढाकेर स्वस्थ राख्न लगाइने बाली।

terms.basis: FAO AGROVOC c_1936 'cover plants': 'Crop grown during fallow periods to protect soil, recycle nutrients and control weeds.' (opened 2026-11-12)

say.en: A machine circling the Earth that sees wide areas at once, but not every detail.
say.ne: पृथ्वीको वरिपरि घुम्ने यन्त्र, जसले ठूलो क्षेत्र एकैपटक देख्छ तर हरेक सानो कुरा होइन।

terms.basis: NASA challenge consideration: how satellite observations differ from ground-based measurements

say.en: A reading taken at one spot on the ground: exact there, but only there.
say.ne: जमिनको एउटै ठाउँमा लिइएको नाप: त्यहाँ ठ्याक्कै, तर त्यहाँ मात्र।

terms.basis: NASA challenge consideration (as above); our ground readings are the Kathmandu Airport station (GHCN-Daily) and the soil probe

say.en: Mixing space, computer and ground readings so each one fixes the others' weak spots.
say.ne: अन्तरिक्ष, कम्प्युटर र जमिनका नाप मिलाएर एउटाको कमजोरी अर्कोले सच्याउने तरिका।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Probe fusion' (scalar Kalman update) and decision A (station correction of POWER temperature)

say.en: Worked out by a computer from physics and other readings, not measured directly.
say.ne: सिधै नापिएको होइन, भौतिक नियम र अरू नापबाट कम्प्युटरले निकालेको।

terms.basis: Golden rule 8: NASA POWER, SMAP L4 and the twin are labelled model-based. On screens: 'worked out by computer'

say.en: Our computer copy of your field that replays each season's water and crops.
say.ne: हरेक मौसमको पानी र बाली फेरि चलाउने तपाईंको खेतको कम्प्युटर नमुना।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md 'What this repo is'

say.en: This year's harvest compared with the best this field could give, never in tonnes.
say.ne: यो खेतले दिन सक्ने सबैभन्दा राम्रो उब्जनीसँग दाँज्दा यस वर्षको उब्जनी, टनमा होइन।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Yield as a percentage of potential' (FAO-33) and golden rule 11

say.en: Days when the soil is too dry for the crop to drink freely.
say.ne: माटो यति सुक्खा हुन्छ कि बालीले सजिलै पानी खान नसक्ने दिनहरू।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md: a dry day is a day with Ks < 1 during a crop season (FAO-56 eq. 84)

say.en: Water brought to the field by canal, well or pipe, as well as rain.
say.ne: वर्षाबाहेक कुलो, इनार वा पाइपबाट खेतमा ल्याइएको पानी।

terms.basis: config/fields water_source; every replay runs rain-fed and irrigated (owner, 2026-11-12)

say.en: A crop season whose rain was among the lowest fifth of all seasons since 2001.
say.ne: सन् २००१ यताका सबैभन्दा सुक्खा पाँचौं भागमा पर्ने बाली मौसम।

terms.basis: rules.yaml events.drought_decile_max (rainfall deciles 1-2; owner-approved 2026-11-12, owner's batch decisions item 17)

say.en: A year whose heaviest rain day was among the heaviest fifth of all years.
say.ne: जुन वर्षको सबैभन्दा भारी पानी परेको दिन सबै वर्षका सबैभन्दा भारी पाँचौं भागमा पर्छ।

terms.basis: rules.yaml events.flood_decile_min (owner's batch decisions item 18, 2026-11-12): the year's wettest crop-season day (ETCCDI Rx1day) in deciles 9-10 of the record's years ('much above normal', Gibbs & Maher 1967 classes). Fixed in advance; never tuned on the known floods

say.en: A small stick pushed into the soil that measures how wet and warm it is.
say.ne: माटो कति ओसिलो र तातो छ भनेर नाप्न माटोमा गाडिने सानो यन्त्र।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Probe bridge'

say.en: How far a number could be from the truth; on screen, fog shows it.
say.ne: कुनै अङ्क साँचोभन्दा कति फरक हुन सक्छ; स्क्रिनमा कुहिरोले यो देखाउँछ।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md: 'sure' (0 to 1) from the probe fusion; projections are ranges (golden rule 11)

say.en: All water held across a wide area, seen by satellites; not your own well.
say.ne: भू-उपग्रहले नापेको ठूलो क्षेत्रभरिको सबै पानी; तपाईंको आफ्नै इनार होइन।

terms.basis: rules.yaml groundwater.caveat (owner, 2026-11-12): GRACE/GRACE-FO JPL mascon, about 330 km across

say.en: Soil carried away from the field by rain water or wind.
say.ne: पानी वा हावाले खेतको माटो बगाएर लैजाने क्रिया।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Erosion (RUSLE)'

say.en: Rain that flows off the field instead of soaking into the soil.
say.ne: माटोमा नपसी खेतबाट बगेर जाने वर्षाको पानी।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Runoff (SCS curve number)'

say.en: A crop like lentil whose root bacteria turn nitrogen from air into plant food.
say.ne: मसुरजस्तो बाली, जसको जराका ब्याक्टेरियाले हावाको नाइट्रोजनलाई बिरुवाको खाना बनाउँछन्।

terms.basis: crop_explainers.json nitrogen_fixing (FAO 2016, 'Soils and pulses: symbiosis for life', printed p. 43)

say.en: A crop whose roots reach water and food deep in the soil.
say.ne: जरा माटोको गहिराइसम्म पुगेर पानी र खाना लिन सक्ने बाली।

terms.basis: crop_explainers.json deep_rooting (FAO-56 Table 22; FAO Conservation Agriculture)

say.en: A crop that still gives some harvest when the rains are short.
say.ne: पानी कम पर्दा पनि केही उब्जनी दिने बाली।

terms.basis: crop_explainers.json drought_tolerant (FAO 2023 International Year of Millets; ICRISAT)

say.en: Pests and diseases that build up when crops of one family follow each other.
say.ne: एउटै जातका बाली लगातार लगाउँदा बढ्दै जाने कीरा र रोग।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Score': pest-cycle breaks (no same crop family back to back); FAO Conservation Agriculture, 'Species diversification' (crop rotation prevents carry-over of crop-specific pests and diseases)

say.en: Rotting roots, leaves and dung in the soil that make it dark and crumbly.
say.ne: माटोलाई कालो र खुकुलो बनाउने कुहिएका जरा, पात र गोबर।

terms.basis: FAO Conservation Agriculture, 'Soil organic cover' and 'Benefits of CA'; SoilGrids soc (organic carbon)

say.en: Days hotter than nine in ten of this place's usual days.
say.ne: यस ठाउँका सामान्य दस दिनमध्ये नौ दिनभन्दा तातो दिनहरू।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Trends': hot days are above the local 90th percentile of Tmax

say.en: The size of the patch of land that one satellite or computer number covers.
say.ne: भू-उपग्रह वा कम्प्युटरको एउटा अङ्कले ढाक्ने जमिनको टुक्राको आकार।

terms.basis: Golden rule 8: every number carries its source, resolution and years

say.en: A computer picture of possible future weather, given as a range, not a forecast.
say.ne: भविष्यको सम्भावित मौसमको कम्प्युटर अनुमान, दायराका रूपमा, पक्का भविष्यवाणी होइन।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Future': NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 delta change, SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5, reported as a range

say.en: A sum that mixes a guess and a reading, trusting the surer one more.
say.ne: अनुमान र नापलाई मिलाउने हिसाब, जुन बढी पक्का छ त्यसलाई बढी भरोसा गर्दै।

terms.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Probe fusion' (scalar Kalman update; pipeline/twin/kalman.py, rules.yaml probe.kalman): before = the twin alone, after = the twin with the soil stick's reading; sure = 1 - sqrt(P / P0)

never_on_screens._about: Jargon with no glossary entry of its own: never shown to farmers at all.
